title: 1. Flowchart — shapes, edges, colors
source:
flowchart LR
    subgraph Intake["Intake 🌀"]
        A([Start]) --> B[/Parse request/]
        B --> C{Valid?}
    end
    subgraph Store["Storage"]
        D[(PostgreSQL)]
        E[(Redis cache)]
    end
    C -->|yes| F[[Process]]:::ok
    C ==>|retry| B
    C -.->|no| G((Discard)):::bad
    F --> D
    F -.-> E
    F ~~~ H[Queued]
    H --> I(((Done))):::ok
    classDef ok fill:#d5e8d4,stroke:#82b366,color:#1a4314
    classDef bad fill:#f8cecc,stroke:#b85450,color:#571210
    style A fill:#fff2cc,stroke:#d6b656

title: 2. Flowchart — more shapes and directions
source:

    A[/CLI input\] --> B{{Normalize}}
    B --> C[/Flags/]:::warn
    C --> D[(config store)]
    D --> E>Emit report]

    F --> G[/Done/]
    classDef warn fill:#ffe6cc,stroke:#d79b00

title: 3. Sequence — actors, boxes, frames, autonumber
source:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant GW as API gateway
    box rgb(222, 235, 247) Core
    participant S as Service
    participant DB as Database
    end
    U->>GW: POST /orders
    GW->>S: forward
    activate S
    alt happy path
        S->>DB: insert order
        DB-->>S: ok
    else conflict
        S-xGW: 409
    end
    S-->>GW: 201 Created
    deactivate S
    Note over GW,S: retries are client-side
    GW--)U: async webhook

title: 4. State — composite, choice, fork/join, colors
source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Draft
    Draft --> Review: submit
    state Review {
        [*] --> Screening
        Screening --> Detailed: pass
        Screening --> [*]: reject
    }
    Review --> Approved: sign off
    Review --> Draft: request changes
    state check <<choice>>
    Approved --> check
    check --> Live: metrics ok
    check --> Paused: regressions
    state Live {
        state forkState <<fork>>
        [*] --> forkState
        forkState --> Serving
        forkState --> Caching
        state joinState <<join>>
        Serving --> joinState
        Caching --> joinState
        joinState --> [*]
    }
    Live --> [*]: sunset
    note right of Review : SLA is 2 days
    classDef hot fill:#f8cecc,stroke:#b85450
    class Live hot
